onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/locomotion.schema.json, set mv_c_motion_mode to {{mv_c_motion_mode}}]
Set the locomotion motion mode to {{mv_c_motion_mode}}. Kinematic=addMoveDelta each frame. Force-Based=useForceAsInputs=true, physics engine handles acceleration.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/locomotion.schema.json, set mv_c_slide_lock to {{mv_c_slide_lock}}]
Set the slide direction lock to {{mv_c_slide_lock}}. On=movement direction locked to initial direction on stick press, preventing drift.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/locomotion.schema.json, set mv_t_move_speed to {{mv_t_move_speed}}]
Set the player character's moveSpeed to {{mv_t_move_speed}} in MovementAbility. Current: slide_lock={{mv_c_slide_lock}}

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/locomotion.schema.json, set mv_t_slide_threshold to {{mv_t_slide_threshold}}]
Set the slideDirectionLockThreshold to {{mv_t_slide_threshold}} in MovementAbility. Input must exceed this magnitude to trigger lock.
